list.title: Accounts
list.archived_hint: Left out of net worth and the home page; their history is kept and still searchable

empty.title: You don't have any accounts yet

list.archive_confirm: Once archived, you can't record transactions on it or use it as an import target, but its history is kept. Its balance of {{balance}} will be removed from net worth.
list.unarchive_confirm: You'll be able to record on it again, and its balance of {{balance}} will count towards net worth once more.
list.delete_confirm: This can't be undone. Only an account with no transactions can be deleted.
list.delete_disabled_hint: This account has transactions — archive it instead
list.no_rate_hint: {{count}} accounts can't be converted right now

form.name_hint: Members of the ledgers you share it into see this name too — make it specific
form.name_duplicate_hint: There's already an account with this name — they're still tracked separately
form.currency_locked_hint: An account's currency can't be changed after it's created — changing it would muddle past transactions. To switch currency, create a new account and archive this one.
form.opening_balance_hint: Balance = opening balance + the sum of every transaction on this account. The opening balance lives on the account, not as a transaction — it won't show up in the transaction list.
form.opening_balance_invalid: That's not a valid amount — 4 decimal places at most
form.credit_debt_hint: Enter how much you currently owe the bank — it's stored as a negative number
form.type_change_converted: Opening balance converted for the new type: {{amount}}
form.opening_balance_change_confirm: This immediately affects all historical balances and net worth. Save anyway?

share.hint: Once shared, the other members of that ledger can record with this account too; you can use it in any of your ledgers
share.no_ledgers: You're not in any ledger yet — come back and share it once you create or join one
share.unshared_toast: Stopped sharing “{{account}}” to “{{ledger}}” — other members can no longer record with it; existing entries stay
share.save_failed_toast: The account was saved, but not every sharing change went through — try again
